idea-plugin.name: Git Hygiene Companion
idea-plugin.description:
Lightweight inline git blame — author and date at the end of each line — designed from the ground up to never block the editor. Every git operation runs off the EDT via a real git subprocess, with an aggressive, two-key cache (repo HEAD commit + the file's own modification time) so switching between files never triggers a recompute. A commit, checkout or pull moves HEAD and is picked up on the next repaint, recomputed in the background; while a file has unsaved edits its annotations are hidden until it is saved, so a line is never labeled with another line's author.

No git4idea dependency — shells out to the real git binary for everything, keeping the entire git interaction surface inside one well-understood, already-proven-safe pattern.

Free. No license nags, no telemetry, no popups.
